reviews.review:
Overall I liked it. There are a lot of neat mechanics to the game like emotion and getting new cards and abilities as you progress through nodes, I felt some of the cards and abilities could be explained better as they're introduced but I grew to understand them as I played. I'm not too experienced with card battlers but even I found this one was kinda easy, at least from what's out now. There were a few harder parts where I had to strategize and it wasn't mind numbing, so that's fine. I'm sure as more content is released it will have a more balanced difficulty. The artstyle was nice and there were a few funny moments in the story, but the dialogue was lengthy and skip-worthy most the time.

I'd say its worth the price, especially knowing there is a lot of development going on and future plans. It's just not amazing (yet).
